verdict: Organic search is active, but phone calls from your profiles remain critically low.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came entirely from organic local search — no paid ads ran on any channel. Your three Google Business profiles generated 1,069 impressions and 185 total actions, with direction requests strong at 154. However, only 5 calls came from those impressions, and one profile with 354 impressions produced zero calls this period — a clear gap between people finding you and picking up the phone. We're reviewing the profile setup and call prompts to close that gap. Organic engagement also went quiet over the last three days of the window, which we're watching closely heading into next week.
